description: This Java class serves as a wrapper around the InterestRateChartSlabRepository, providing methods to find, save, delete, and flush InterestRateChartSlab entities. Its primary role is to include not-found detection logic in the findOneWithNotFoundDetection method, throwing a custom exception if an entity isn't found. It simplifies error handling related to InterestRateChartSlab retrieval within the project.
